# Lux Tiles & Stones

> Premium tile and natural stone supplier serving residential and commercial projects across Greater Los Angeles. Glass tile blends, natural stone, and large-format surfaces at wholesale pricing, with delivery to the job site.

## What we supply

- **Kitchens** — glass tile blends and natural stone for backsplashes and surfaces.
- **Bathrooms** — wall, floor, and shower tile and natural stone.
- **Pool & Spa** — waterline and feature tile.
- **Feature Walls** — statement tile and stone for residential and commercial spaces.
- **Large-format surfaces** — for both residential and commercial builds.

## Commercial division

Large commercial tile projects for supermarkets, apartments, hotels, and shopping centers. Builder-focused, with project support from bidding to completion, reliable and insured service, and a massive in-stock inventory.

## Why Lux Tiles & Stones

- Wholesale / builder pricing.
- Delivery to the job site.
- 1,000+ projects supplied.
- One partner for every surface — residential and commercial.

## Service area

Greater Los Angeles, including Los Angeles, Calabasas, Encino, Burbank, and Pasadena.
